thread:
Oliver: Quick idea — can we add a 'hotfix' mode to the deploy workflow that bundles a lightweight rollback playbook + pinning convenience flags? would make emergency patches less hand-wavey.

Mina: +1. important to define automatic triggers though — do we want the bot to auto-initiate rollback or just surface the playbook? :thinking:

Tess: I can sketch a minimal playbook template. prefer bot to surface and optionally auto-run if thresholds hit. autos should be opt-in per-deploy.

Ryan: proposed CLI syntax for discussion:
```/deploy run --env=prod --tag=hotfix-2026-03-20 --pin=sha1:abc123 --hotfix-window=30m --auto-rollback=optional```
(then bot prompts for quick notes/release notes)

deploy-bot: I can support new flags: `--hotfix-window` (duration), `--pin` (commit/sha), and `--auto-rollback` (bool). preview: `/deploy preview --tag=hotfix` shows playbook + checklist.

Mina: suggested thresholds to wire into optional auto-rollback: error_rate >= 3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 2x for 10m. default should be conservative and require an explicit opt-in.

Tess: playbook skeleton (short):
```
1) Verify incident channel and paging list
2) Pin model/service to previous stable if rollback chosen: `pin to: sha1:def456`
3) Run smoke tests: `scripts/smoke-prod.sh`
4) Post release-note stub and trigger canary (5%)
5) If failure persists, escalate and run full rollback script
```
Keep it 1 page.

Oliver: also include a release-note template the bot can autofill from deploy args (who, why, impact, rollback plan). double-check change window before allowing auto-rollback. if inside blackout, require manual confirm.

Ryan: idea: add generator command to create a playbook/template per-release: `/deploy generate hotfix-playbook --name="web-hotfix-123"` outputs a markdown file in the repo and posts a link to the PR.

Tess: I'll draft the playbook + release-note template in the infra repo and add example smoke test hooks. who wants to review?

Mina: Assigning Tess to PR the templates, Ryan to add e2e to the deploy-bot repo, Oliver will sign off on SLO thresholds. can we aim for a small beta this week?

Oliver: Sounds good. Tess, ping me in the PR and I'll review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: `deploy-bot` will post an agenda in #eng-releases at 09:00 UTC tomorrow to sync owners.

Tess: will do a first pass today and tag reviewers.

Ryan: I'll add tests and a simple sim for the auto-rollback logic.

Mina: great — thanks all.
